title: Thermal conduction in doped 3C-SiC published in Applied Physics Reviews
titleZh: 掺杂 3C-SiC 热输运研究发表于 Applied Physics Reviews
body: The group's work on thermal conduction in doped 3C-SiC has been published in Applied Physics Reviews. The study experimentally reveals the effect of resonant phonon scattering on thermal transport, deepening the understanding of heat conduction in wide-bandgap semiconductors. With a thermal conductivity second only to diamond among large-wafer materials, together with full compatibility with silicon processing, 3C-SiC is a promising candidate material for through-silicon via (TSV) applications in advanced integration.
bodyZh: 课题组关于掺杂 3C-SiC 热输运的研究成果发表于 Applied Physics Reviews。该研究实验揭示了共振声子散射对热输运的影响，深化了对宽禁带半导体热传导机制的理解。3C-SiC 热导率在大尺寸晶圆材料中仅次于金刚石，且与硅工艺完全兼容，是先进集成中硅通孔（TSV）应用的理想候选材料。
